## Endpoints

### Data Read (8)
- `GET /{id}` — Get details for a specific lead by its ID.
- `GET //getTrialPeriodFromProperties.htm` — Determine the trial period based on lead properties.
- `GET /advanced/{advancedId}` — Get details for an advanced lead profile by ID.
- `GET /inclusionExclusionList/getLists.htm` — Retrieve inclusion/exclusion lists for lead filtering.
- `GET /other/customer-executive-info.htm` — Get executive information for a specific customer.
- `GET /subscription/plans.htm` — View available subscription plans.
- `GET /user/details.htm` — Get details about the current user.
- `GET /v0/getMemberEntityWithSubscription.htm` — Get member entity details with subscription info.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /{id}` — Update information for a specific lead.
- `POST /attribution_tracking/conversions/assign` — Assign a conversion to an attribution tracking source.
- `POST /integrations/hubspot/utk/v2` — Update a HubSpot user token.
- `POST /wa/` — Send a message via WhatsApp.

### Search (2)
- `GET /savedsearches/search.htm` — Execute a saved lead search.
- `POST /autocomplete/industrysectors.htm` — Autocomplete industry sectors for lead targeting.

### Media (1)
- `GET /fileenrich/entry.htm` — Retrieve an enriched file entry.

### Core API (2)
- `POST /monitoring/metrics/widget/init/v3` — Initialize a widget monitoring metrics.
- `POST /widget_bootstrap/ping/v2` — Ping the widget bootstrap service.
